title: QML-PipeGuard: Detecting Channel-Substitution Attacks on Quantum Machine Learning Pipelines in Untrusted Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2605.25066v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As machine-learning workloads move onto quantum hardware they inherit a trust problem classical AI deployments have largely solved and quantum ones have not: quantum machine learning (QML) is already sold as a cloud service, and a customer cannot check that the circuit they paid for is actually the circuit that ran. We show the gap is exploitable. A malicious or cost-cutting provider can substitute the declared quantum channel with one that reproduces every accuracy test the customer performs, passes the single-observable checks used in practice, and still differs from the declared computation at the channel level. We call this a channel-substitution attack and instantiate it in three deployments: audit evasion, service downgrade, and result forgery in reproducibility review. QML-PipeGuard detects the attack at runtime from measurement statistics the customer already collects. Its guarantee is two-sided, stated in the distance

translated_title: QML-PipeGuard：在不可信云端检测量子机器学习流水线中的信道替换攻击
translated_abstract: 随着机器学习工作负载迁移到量子硬件上，它们继承了一个经典AI部署已基本解决、而量子部署尚未解决的信任问题：量子机器学习（QML）已经作为云服务出售，但客户无法验证自己付费购买的电路是否就是实际运行的电路。我们证明这一信任缺口是可以被利用的。恶意或为削减成本的提供者可以用另一个量子信道替换所声明的量子信道，该替代信道能够复现客户执行的每一项精度测试，并通过实践中常用的单可观测量检查，同时在信道层面与所声明的计算存在差异。我们将其称为信道替换攻击，并在三种部署场景中对其进行了实例化：审计规避、服务降级，以及可复现性审查中的结果伪造。QML-PipeGuard在运行时利用客户本已收集的测量统计信息检测该攻击。其保证是双向的，以距离……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出QML-PipeGuard，一种在运行时利用客户已有的测量统计来检测不可信云端量子机器学习服务中信道替换攻击的方案，可防范审计规避、服务降级和可复现性审查中的结果伪造。
en_tdlr: QML-PipeGuard is a runtime detection scheme that uses measurement statistics already collected by customers to detect channel-substitution attacks in untrusted cloud-based quantum machine learning services, defending against audit evasion, service downgrade, and result forgery in reproducibility review.
